summary: Keep one active Boingo Wireless record under DigitalBridge Partners II, formerly Digital Colony Partners II. The take-private closed on June 2, 2021 through White Sands Parent and Bidco, current 2026 company materials still call Boingo a DigitalBridge company, InfraBridge has no direct equity evidence, and the reported 2024 sale process did not produce a disclosed signed or closed exit.
